title: ReceiptRef
description: A portable pointer to a receipt (ModelInvocationReceipt, ResourceProvisionReceipt, VerificationReceipt, OptimizationReceipt, HumanApprovalReceipt, ...). Objects carry ReceiptRefs in their receipts[] array so the full receipt can live in the receipt store while the object stays small.

receipt_type.description: the receipt's schema name, e.g. ModelInvocationReceipt

store_ref.description: where the full receipt lives (logical, not a raw path)
